contentPattern: Optional first row with text only: the label (e.g. "Join the conversation:"). Then one row per social link (single cell holding the link; link text is the accessible name). Network icons are chosen from the link hostname (Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X/Twitter; RSS for feed URLs).

usage.description: Join the conversation strip with square dark social icon buttons, right-aligned on desktop.

reuseGuidance: Use wherever social follow links are needed; add or remove link rows freely, unknown hosts render as text buttons.
